training-config.yaml:
---
# Source: sagemaker-training/templates/training-config.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: training-config-{{name}}
data:
  config.yaml: |-
    run:
      name: '{{name}}'
      model_type: amazon.nova-micro-v1:0:128k
      model_name_or_path: nova-micro/prod
      replicas: '{{replicas}}'
      data_s3_path: '{{data_s3_path}}'
      output_s3_path: '{{output_s3_path}}'
      mlflow_tracking_uri: '{{mlflow_tracking_uri}}'
      mlflow_experiment_name: '{{mlflow_experiment_name}}'
      mlflow_run_name: '{{mlflow_run_name}}'
    training_config:
      max_length: 16384
      global_batch_size: '{{global_batch_size}}'
      trainer:
        max_epochs: '{{max_epochs}}'
      model:
        hidden_dropout: 0.0
        attention_dropout: 0.0
        ffn_dropout: 0.0
        optim:
          lr: '{{learning_rate}}'
          name: distributed_fused_adam
          adam_w_mode: true
          eps: 1.0e-08
          weight_decay: '{{weight_decay}}'
          betas:
          - 0.9
          - 0.999
          sched:
            warmup_steps: '{{warmup_steps}}'
            constant_steps: 0
            min_lr: '{{min_lr}}'
        dpo_cfg:
          beta: '{{adam_beta}}'
        peft:
          peft_scheme: lora
          lora_tuning:
            loraplus_lr_ratio: '{{learning_rate_ratio}}'
            alpha: '{{lora_alpha}}'
            adapter_dropout: 0.01

---
# Source: sagemaker-training/templates/training.yaml
apiVersion: kubeflow.org/v1
kind: PyTorchJob
metadata:
  name: {{name}}
  namespace: {{namespace}}
  annotations:
    "annotation_key_1": "annotation-value-1"
  labels:
    app: {{name}}
    "placeholder": "custom_labels"
spec:
  pytorchReplicaSpecs:
    Master:
      replicas: 1
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
      template:
        metadata:
          labels:
            "placeholder": "custom_labels"
        spec:
          tolerations:
            - key: "sagemaker.amazonaws.com/RestrictedNode"
              operator: "Equal"
              value: "Worker"
              effect: "NoSchedule"
          priorityClassName: test_pc_name
          serviceAccountName: placeholder_service_account_name
          initContainers:
            - name: init-container
              image: {{init_container_image}}
              imagePullPolicy: Always
              env:
                - name: AWS_REGION
                  value: "us-east-1"
                - name: INSTANCE_TYPE
                  value: "{{instance_type}}"
              volumeMounts:
              - name: fsx-path-init
                mountPath: /sagemaker/fsx/init
              - mountPath: /config
                name: training-config
              - mountPath: /var/log/aws/clusters
                name: logs
              - name: k8s-ca-cert
                mountPath: /etc/kubernetes/pki/ca.crt
                readOnly: true
          containers:
          - name: pytorch
            image: {{container_image}}
            env:
              - name: AWS_REGION
                value: "us-east-1"
              - name: INSTANCE_TYPE
                value: "{{instance_type}}"
            imagePullPolicy: Always
            resources:
              limits:
                nvidia.com/gpu: 8
                vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 32
              requests:
                nvidia.com/gpu: 8
                vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 32
            securityContext:
              capabilities:
                add: [ "IPC_LOCK" ]
            volumeMounts:
            - name: fsx-path-main
              mountPath: /sagemaker/fsx/main
            - mountPath: /config
              name: training-config
            - mountPath: /dev/shm
              name: dshm
            - mountPath: /var/log/aws/clusters
              name: logs
            - mountPath: /sagemaker/fsx/output_artifacts
              name: fsx-path-output-artifacts
            - name: tmp-storage
              mountPath: /tmp
          affinity:
            nodeAffinity:
              requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
                nodeSelectorTerms:
                  - matchExpressions:
                    - key: "example_label_key"
                      operator: In
                      values:
                        - "expected-label-value-1"
                        - "expected-label-value-2"
                    - key: "node.kubernetes.io/instance-type"
                      operator: In
                      values:
                        - "{{instance_type}}"
                    - key: "sagemaker.amazonaws.com/instance-group-type"
                      operator: In
                      values:
                        - "Restricted"
          volumes:
            - name: fsx-path-main
              hostPath:
                path: /sagemaker/fsx/main
                type: DirectoryOrCreate
            - name: fsx-path-init
              hostPath:
                path: /sagemaker/fsx/init
                type: DirectoryOrCreate
            - configMap:
                name: training-config-{{name}}
              name: training-config
            - name: dshm
              emptyDir:
                medium: Memory
            - name: logs
              hostPath:
                path: /var/log/aws/clusters
                type: DirectoryOrCreate
            - name: fsx-path-output-artifacts
              hostPath:
                path: /sagemaker/fsx/output_artifacts
                type: DirectoryOrCreate
            - name: tmp-storage

              - mountPath: /var/log/aws/clusters

              - name: k8s-ca-cert

                readOnly: true
          containers:
          - name: pytorch
            image: {{container_image}}
            env:
              - name: AWS_REGION

              - name: INSTANCE_TYPE

metadata.Name: nova_micro_1_0_p5_p4d_gpu_lora_dpo
metadata.DisplayName: Nova Micro LoRA DPO on GPU

adam_beta.description: Controls how strongly the model enforces preference rankings. Higher values make the model more sensitive to preference differences.
adam_beta.hint: Must be a value between 0.001 and 0.1

data_s3_path.description: S3 URI path to training dataset
data_s3_path.invalid_format_error: Invalid S3 path. Please use the format s3://bucket-name/folder/filename.ext

global_batch_size.description: Total number of training samples processed per optimizer step. Larger values improve training stability but use more memory.
global_batch_size.hint: Choose from the available batch size options

learning_rate.description: Step size for weight updates during optimization. Controls how much model weights change per gradient step. Set lower for RL (e.g., 1e-5) to avoid policy collapse; higher for SFT/DPO (e.g., 1e-4).
learning_rate.hint: Must be a value between 0 and 1

learning_rate_ratio.description: Scaling factor that controls the relative learning rate between LoRA adapter parameters and base model parameters.
learning_rate_ratio.hint: Must be a value between 1.0 and 70.0

lora_alpha.description: LoRA scaling factor. The effective learning rate for LoRA adapters scales as alpha/rank. Typically set to 2x the LoRA rank.

max_context_length.description: Maximum sequence length for training inputs. Determines which instance types will be used based on memory requirements.
max_context_length.hint: Must be a value between 1 and 131072

max_epochs.description: Number of complete passes through the entire training dataset. More epochs allow the model to learn patterns more thoroughly but increase training time and risk of overfitting.
max_epochs.hint: Must be a value between 1 and 100

min_lr.description: Lowest learning rate the scheduler decays to during training. Prevents the learning rate from dropping to zero in later steps.
min_lr.hint: Must be a value between 1e-07 and 1.0

mlflow_experiment_name.description: MLflow Groups related training runs for comparison. Uses the custom model name by default.

mlflow_run_name.description: Identifies this specific training run within the experiment. Autogenerated by default.

mlflow_tracking_uri.description: MLflow tracking server URI for experiment logging

name.hint: A training job with the name {name} will be created
name.invalid_format_error: It should be maximum 63 alphanumeric characters and cannot include spaces. It must also be unique within your account in an AWS Region

namespace.description: Namespace for HyperPod cluster resources (default: kubeflow)
namespace.invalid_format_error: Please enter a valid namespace with only alphanumeric characters and hyphens and should be in lowercase

output_s3_path.description: The S3 path where the trained model artifacts are stored after the job completes.
output_s3_path.invalid_format_error: Invalid S3 path. Please use the format s3://bucket-name/folder

replicas.description: Number of training pods (adjust based on cluster capacity)

warmup_steps.description: Absolute number of training steps over which the learning rate linearly warms up from 0 to the target value.
warmup_steps.hint: Must be a value between 0 and 100

weight_decay.description: L2 regularization coefficient applied to model weights during optimization. Helps prevent overfitting by penalizing large weights.

instance_type.description: Compute instance type for the HyperPod training job
